exposure: advanced glycation end product- bovine serum albumin medium (aMEM+AGE-BSA medium)
cohort: Mesenchymal stem cells were isolated from human umbilical cords, cultured, and expanded up to passage 5 for the study.
finding: Advanced glycation end product- bovine serum albumin enhances vascular endothelial growth factor secretion by mesenchymal stem cells, with maximum secretion occurring on day 3.
